title: Which Days Count as Free Storage Days — Repair Estimates & Appointments Lot Calendar
content:
**Calendar rule.** Which days count as free storage days on a Repair Estimates & Appointments storage statement follows how the vehicle can leave the lot:

1. For a vehicle recorded as not drivable that arrived on a network-arranged tow, a tow-in charge having been posted on the booking, only **Monday to Friday** count as free storage days and Saturdays and Sundays are passed over, because the network releases a vehicle to a flatbed on business days only.
2. For a vehicle recorded as not drivable with no tow-in charge ever posted on the booking, which came in on the owner's own carrier, **Monday to Saturday** count and Sundays are passed over, because that carrier may also collect on a Saturday.
3. For every other vehicle every calendar day counts.

The free storage days are counted forward from the estimate written date, which is day zero and is not itself counted. The free storage period runs from the day after the estimate written date through the day on which the last free storage day is counted, any passed-over days falling inside it included.

| Recorded as drivable? | Tow-in charge ever posted on the booking? | Days that count |
|---|---|---|
| No | Yes | Monday to Friday |
| No | No | Monday to Saturday |
| Yes | Either | Every calendar day |

**Day charts** (hypothetical statements with 3 free storage days)

| Calendar | Estimate written on | Days counted | Last free storage day |
|---|---|---|---|
| Monday to Friday | Wednesday | Thursday (1), Friday (2), Saturday and Sunday passed over, Monday (3) | Monday |
| Monday to Friday | Saturday | Sunday passed over, Monday (1), Tuesday (2), Wednesday (3) | Wednesday |
| Monday to Friday | Monday | Tuesday (1), Wednesday (2), Thursday (3) | Thursday |
| Monday to Saturday | Friday | Saturday (1), Sunday passed over, Monday (2), Tuesday (3) | Tuesday |
| Monday to Saturday | Sunday | Monday (1), Tuesday (2), Wednesday (3) | Wednesday |
| Every calendar day | Friday | Saturday (1), Sunday (2), Monday (3) | Monday |
